character: Certified Powderhounds Gem — hidden freeride paradise in the Haute Maurienne Vanoise. 65km uncrowded pistes, superb off-piste with guaranteed groomed exits. 5 min from Modane TGV station. Excellent value.
description: La Norma is a hidden gem in the Haute Maurienne Vanoise, known by powder seekers for excellent off-piste with easy exits onto groomed trails. 65km of pistes, 1,350m-2,750m (1,400m vertical), 12 lifts. Part of a 5-resort valley (with Valfréjus, Aussois, Val Cenis, Bonneval sur Arc) that can be ski-safaried in a week. Just 5 minutes from Modane — a TGV station on the Paris-Lyon-Turin-Milan high-speed line. Uncrowded, affordable, with a westerly aspect that gets more sun than the shaded village below.

non_ski_activities.off_piste: Certified freeride gem — long off-piste descents from any point on the mountain with guaranteed groomed trail exit. Norma II chair (2,750m) accesses extensive high-alpine terrain.
non_ski_activities.multi_resort: Part of 5-resort Haute Maurienne Vanoise — ski safari to Valfréjus, Aussois, Val Cenis, Bonneval sur Arc all within easy reach.
non_ski_activities.access: 5 min from Modane TGV station (Paris-Lyon-Turin-Milan line). Regular buses to all 5 Haute Maurienne resorts from Modane. 2.25h Geneva, 2.5h Lyon, 1.5h Turin.
non_ski_activities.other: Snowshoeing, tobogganing, mountain restaurants (Plateau de la Repose), village dining

honest_drawbacks: Village shaded in winter (ski terrain has better sun)
